processing: Cutouts from the IRSA service centred on the target.
Bilinear resampling to a common TAN grid (north up, east left, 12.30"/px; binned 2x2).
No temporal interpolation: every frame is a real exposure.
Units MJy/sr; the contrast stretch is applied in the browser.

case.expected: Psyche (V~11.2) moves ~0.27 deg/day; JPL sb_ident must mark it in every frame.
